about: Generated tables of docs/benchmarks.md, rendered by docs/scripts/render_benchmarks.py. 'rows', 'label' and 'source' come from bench/results/<machine>/<date>-consolidated/consolidated.json (the label as the docs print it); 'chain' is the end-to-end table of the same run's CONSOLIDATED.md. Units: microseconds per document (rows; pyroid_us is one thread on CPython 3.15t, pyroid_us_8_threads a pool of 8, incumbents one process on CPython 3.13) and seconds per run (chain). Every value is a string copied from the source, never computed.
